The '''Big Sink''' was the name given to the fractured ice sheets in the [[Northern Snowdrift Hills]] in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth's]] [[Clabburn Tundra]]. The Sink was caused by a subterranean volcanic cavern that vented in the center of the Sink; [[Frostclaw's Den]] was located underneath the Sink, branching off of the volcanic sinkhole.
